newsitem.title: USA: Lawter Int'l Q1 net slips as margins fall.
newsitem.headline: Lawter Int'l Q1 net slips as margins fall.

text.p: Lawter International Inc said Thursday earnings in the first quarter ended March 31 fell slightly as its margins declined in the period.
Lawter reported net income of $5.9 million, or $0.13 a share, compared to $6.1 million, or $0.14, in the first quarter of 1996. Sales rose to $50.1 million from $49.4 million last year.

The company said the increased strength of the U.S. dollar hurt sales in Europe and other nations with currencies experiencing weakness against the U.S. dollar. Margins were also hurt by more competition in Europe, a higher tax rate and by acquisition integration costs, Lawter said.
Lawter makes printing ink and thermographic compounds.
Its shares were unchanged Thrusday at 10-5/8.
